scope: Offline deterministic seed-zero full-workload calibration; state-aware aggregate-risk candidate, not a runtime or engine change.

policy.baseline: frozen GH planner at each 300-tick decision boundary
policy.emergency: during overtime with one South lane remaining and a live North tower-targeter, evaluate affordable single-body air cards at legal own-side points where actual current target acquisition selects that tower-targeter and attack range already reaches it; rank by estimated aggregate incoming damage from current air-capable enemies and tower-approaching air-capable units through estimated removal time, then urgency and kill time; replace a coincident baseline command
estimateLimits: aggregate attack risk uses current unit profiles and straight-line approach to the defended lane for soon approachers
predicted counter kill assumes the acquired target remains available and does not model future retargeting
body radii and deployment geometry retain their existing confidence limits
